epistemic_policy: Every discovered record remains CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED until human review.
Similarity does not imply historical descent, common origin or diffusion.
Publication, issue, version, index and discovery dates are preserved separately where available.
Archaeological observations are separated from inferred symbolic, ritual, social or cognitive meaning.
Ancient-DNA affinity, morphology, culture, language, technology and social identity are not interchangeable variables.
Imputed, predicted, reconstructed or model-classified values are not treated as directly observed measurements.
Historical diagnosis or identity is never inferred from resemblance to modern biomedical categories.

new_candidates.title: Two phases of rapid loess deposition during the last deglaciation and mid-Holocene in central Sweden
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: OSL/IRSL plus radiocarbon dating at Brattforsheden resolves intense short postglacial aeolian activity after deglaciation and later Holocene reworking.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Environmental chronology does not by itself establish human migration, subsistence, ritual or cultural causation.

new_candidates.title: Prior ayahuasca experience is associated with improved mental health: observational data from ritualistic settings
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Observational comparison of prior-experience groups in ritualistic ayahuasca settings across mental-health, spiritual-well-being and belief measures.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Self-selection and confounding prevent causal interpretation; modern reports cannot be projected onto ancient altered-state practices.

provenance.publisher: npj Mental Health Research / Springer Nature

new_candidates.title: Material Innovations as Evolutionary Scaffolds: A Niche Construction Perspective on Human Evolution
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Theoretical synthesis connects material innovation, niche construction, scaffolded cognition and gene-culture coevolution while distinguishing stronger and weaker evidential cases.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Theory is not direct evidence that any specific prehistoric innovation caused a genetic, cognitive or social transition.

new_candidates.title: Open Korean Historical Corpus: A Millennia-Scale Diachronic Collection of Public Domain Texts
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: LREC corpus spans roughly 1,300 years, 17.7M documents, 5.1B tokens, 19 sources and six languages including Idu and Hanja-Hangul mixed script.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Corpus statistics, tokenization and OCR are not direct evidence of ethnicity, religion, identity or private belief; preserve document provenance and machine-processing status.

new_candidates.title: Isotope dataset for archaeological biological remains in China
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Nearly 20,700 carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, sulfur and strontium measurements from human, animal and plant remains across Palaeolithic-to-historical China with context and quality fields.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Measurements are observations; diet, mobility, locality and environment are inference layers requiring baseline, tissue, preservation and chronology context.

new_candidates.title: C-Turkey v1.0.0 — First Official Major Release
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Open chronometric repository for Türkiye from post-LGM to Late Ottoman; v1.0.0 reports corrected legacy geolocations, added uncalibrated radiocarbon dates, standardized context/lab metadata and genomic-integration status.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: This release is not itself approved NOEMA evidence; preserve source, lab ID, version and correction provenance before federation.

dating_change.scope: Corrected geolocations and added uncalibrated radiocarbon records; candidate only

provenance.review_context: Release states JOAD referee recommendations were incorporated; corresponding article status requires separate verification.

new_candidates.title: Impact of ecology, subsistence, and climate on language spread rates
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Global model uses >5,500 languages and >2,500 inferred diffusion events to examine reconstructed language-spread rates against ecology, subsistence and Holocene climate events.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Inferred homelands and diffusion rates are model outputs; language spread is not equivalent to demic migration, ancestry, cultural identity or climate causality.

contradictions_or_method_pressures.pressure: Thin/reworked loess can mislead dating; multi-method age reliability matters.
Observational associations do not establish substance or ritual causality.
Theory must not become event-specific causal evidence without tests.
Machine tokenization/OCR and corpus aggregation must remain distinct from validated historical text.
Measured isotope ratios and inferred mobility/diet/locality require separate fields.
Corrected geolocations and new dates can conflict with inherited legacy records; versioned reconciliation is required.
Inferred language homelands/spread rates are model outputs and cannot be collapsed into demic migration or climate causality.
